# Introduction

Teams continue developing their final projects, moving from project planning toward data collection, organization, and analysis.

# Learning goals

1. Refine the final project question and objectives

2. Organize and prepare project data

3. Apply appropriate data science tools and methods

4. Work effectively as a project team

# Lecture - Final Project Development

Guidance on project development, data preparation, and selecting appropriate approaches for the project question.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Team-based project development, data organization, coding, and troubleshooting.

# Discussion - Project Check-in

Teams share progress, challenges, and next steps.

# Assignment

Continue final project development and document project progress in GitHub.

# Looking ahead

Next week we will continue developing the project, with increasing focus on **analysis and modeling**.
